test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Zainab is standing facing a particular direction initially. Then she turns 90° clockwise, after that she turns 180° anticlockwise. Then she turns 135° anticlockwise. She finally turns 180° clockwise. Now she is facing the north-east direction. In which direction was Zainab facing initially before taking any turns?
solution:
Zainab is standing facing particular direction intially. 

1) Then she turns 90° clockwise, after that she turns 180° anticlockwise.

2) Then she turns 135° anticlockwise. She finally turns 180° clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dddb4fc19fe05178b66b86b1f9f43fe10e8e318d387008b7d1f79014f2897f3b.png] 

Now, represent with direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87dc36df18a3abcc316018534fd26544cc6d494d70de63c811af1ae471c091fd.png] 

Clearly, we can see at the starting Zainab is facing East.

Hence, the correct answer is **"East".**
